findings.summary: The frozen evidence does not establish the required timing baseline or provide a serial-versus-concurrent pilot comparison, so the claimed reduction in patch-release elapsed time is unproven.
findings.broken_invariant: The approved plan requires a timing and behavior baseline plus comparison of serial and concurrent pilot behavior; the selected performance.benchmark blueprint additionally requires baseline, raw runs, comparison, threshold, and performance-verdict evidence.

findings.summary: The added qualification-runner tests cover concurrency, dependency barriers, exclusivity, and result ordering, but do not exercise scenario failure propagation or prove that dependent/provider work remains unstarted after a prerequisite failure.
findings.broken_invariant: The approved plan explicitly requires focused regression coverage for failure propagation, and evaluator pass requires negative and concurrency-sensitive paths relevant to the task.

evidence_refs.lines: Added qualification tests exercise bounded concurrency, dependency barriers, report ordering, invalid concurrency, and exclusive latency scenarios, but no scenarioRunner rejection case.

missing_tests: A qualification-runner regression test where a prerequisite scenario rejects and assertions prove rejection propagation, no dependent/provider execution, and fail-closed behavior while already-running independent work settles safely.
A deterministic serial-versus-concurrent pilot benchmark using the same manifest, candidate SHA, environment, run count, and declared noise threshold, with raw elapsed-time results retained.
A provider-capture failure test with multiple concurrently active jobs that verifies deterministic cleanup/failure evidence and confirms no queued jobs start after the first observed failure.
hidden_assumptions: Default concurrency values of four qualification jobs and three provider jobs improve elapsed time in the release environment without resource contention or provider throttling erasing the benefit.
Existing passing checks are treated as sufficient performance evidence even though they validate correctness rather than the required baseline and before/after comparison.
Concurrent failure completion order does not affect externally observed diagnostics or cleanup artifacts beyond the explicitly sorted completed_runs field.
recovery_context: Record the blueprint-required baseline, method, raw serial and concurrent pilot runs, threshold, comparison, and performance verdict on the evaluated SHA; add focused qualification failure-propagation coverage and deterministic concurrent provider-failure evidence, then rerun the four declared checks.
